# rustinion_permission_role (Resource)

Manages a named, reusable permission role: a set of resource-type permissions you assign to users, instead of granting each person each resource type individually. Assign it with rustinion_permission_role_assignment. See permissions.rs in the main repo for how a role resolves against a user's plain org/department role.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name, unique within the tenant case-insensitively — "SRE" and "sre" cannot both exist.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `permission` (Block List) What this role permits. At most one block per `resource_type`. Omitting every block is legal and means the role confers nothing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--permission))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned role ID.

<a id="nestedblock--permission"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permission`

Required:

- `permission_level` (String)
- `resource_type` (String)
